cuts: Finite G, BP−RP, parallax, parallax_over_error, RUWE; parallax > 0 mas; parallax_over_error >= 10; 0 < RUWE < 1.4. No extinction correction. M_G=G+5 log10(parallax_mas)−10.
historical_query: Not recovered for this cache. Filename and columns identify a Gaia TAP cache, not its original selection or sky coverage. Related Rose analysis uses extinction-corrected aggregation; that query is not attributed to this cache.
product: 220 × 230 fixed bins: BP−RP [−1,4.5], M_G [−5,18]. Counts retained; no source IDs or individual interactive field stars. Inverse parallax used only for high-significance field background, never for RAWDOG.
